cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says judgments are published or case status can be looked up online.
cells.note: Fact 2026-11-10: a 2024 government list names a case management system in service for the Children's Court (MUS-005), and the Judiciary's e-filing notices page, current to October 2025, has attorneys filing online at the Commercial Division (MUS-001). Nothing says the public can look up cases or judgments online, so not stage 5.
